about:
Architectural Wood LLC was founded in 1996 in Ronceverte, West Virginia. The company is led by CEO Carol, who emigrated from South Africa in the mid-1980s with her husband Tony and began a career as a contract millwork drafter. Over a 36-year career in the industry, she managed high-profile projects including corporate headquarters and professional sports arenas, and developed a system for producing superior shop drawings.

The shop specializes in architectural millwork fabrication, working with solid lumber, wood veneer, panels, solid surfaces, plastic laminates, metal, glass, and fabrics. A Weeke Venture 114M 4-axis CNC machining center supports precision machining, while an in-house engineering team produces detailed shop drawings and design services for each project.

Projects have included corporate headquarters and professional sports arenas, serving clients in commercial construction and institutional markets. The company emphasizes a direct partnership approach with clients and maintains relationships with vendors and industry associates.

The operation runs on the motto "Craftsmanship Without Compromise - Service Without Excuse" and the tagline "Top Notch Design, First Class Fabrication." Carol's focus on quality workmanship and a pride-driven engineering culture are cited as the foundation of the company's reputation.
